resources.string: Automatic daily copy
Wi-Fi only
Runs when Android allows it, with enough battery and no active call. Keep this device signed in. The last confirmed copy time above is authoritative.
Use another saved recovery key
The candidate must open the current server copy before it replaces the saved key on this phone. The server copy is not re-encrypted.
Receive on this phone
Transfer from this phone
Sign into the same account on both phones. Transfer uses an encrypted server copy; the server never receives the recovery key. The request expires after 10 minutes.
Scan the new phone’s code
Or paste the public QR text
Check request
Show this code on the NEW phone. On the OLD phone, tap Scan the new phone’s code. Keep both screens open.
Is this your new phone? Confirm to share your prepared history, then compare the codes on both screens.
Approve transfer
Compare EVERY group on both phone screens. If any character differs, cancel. Never accept a comparison code sent by someone else.
I compared both screens; all characters match
Could not continue. Check the connection and that both phones use the same account. Then try again.
Close
Prepare history
Copy prepared: %1$s. Newer messages require another copy. Prepare this copy before opening the QR on the new phone.
On the old phone, prepare your history first. Then scan the QR shown on the new phone. Stay signed in to the same account on both phones.
First prepare the history on your old phone. Then scan this code with that phone. Keep both phones open and connected.
Preparing messages and files… Keep this screen open. Large files may take longer.
The history on this OLD phone is ready. On the NEW phone choose Receive on this phone and show its code. Scan that code with this phone.
Cannot scan? Use text instead
End the call before preparing or scanning.
Allow camera access to scan the QR. You can enable it in the app settings.
Open app settings
History received
Your messages and files are now on this phone. You can close this screen.
Receiving your history
3. Compare the two screens
This is your new phone
2. Take your new phone
1. Preparing your history
This code has expired. Show a new code on the new phone and scan it again.
Show my QR code
Scan a new code

Keep your old phone nearby. On it, open Settings → History and backups → Transfer from this phone. Wait until it says the history is ready. Then press the button below. Both phones must be signed in to the same account on the same server.
Keep this screen open while messages and files arrive. If interrupted, continue here — you do not need to scan again.
Continue transfer
Keep both phones connected. We are preparing messages, photos and files. They will stay on this phone. You do not need to copy or enter any keys here.
The codes match
Are the codes identical on both phones?
Compare every letter and number on both screens. Confirm only if everything matches. This lets your new phone receive your private messages and files.
Yes, transfer my history
Now press The codes match on your NEW phone. Leave this screen open until the transfer starts.
Move to another phone

1. On the old phone, choose Transfer from this phone.\n2. On the new phone, choose Receive on this phone to show a QR code.\n3. Scan that code with the OLD phone, compare the codes on both phones and confirm.
Both phones need internet and the same account on the same server. Messages stay on the old phone.
First, prepare this phone
Save the recovery key outside UNYRI and confirm its last 8 characters. Then continue the transfer.
A backup already exists. Below, enter its recovery key and tap Verify and save key. Do not create a replacement key. Then return here to transfer.
Allow an encrypted copy to be uploaded for this transfer. Daily automatic backup is a separate setting.
An earlier backup upload was interrupted. Resolve the unfinished upload below before preparing a new key. Your messages on this phone are not deleted.
This code belongs to another server. Select the same server on both phones, then show a new code.
The phones use different accounts. Check the account shown on each phone, then show a new code.
This is not a valid UNYRI history transfer code. Show a new code from Receive on this phone.
First save or verify the history recovery key on the old phone in History and backups. Your messages stay here.
On the old phone, allow encrypted backup uploads, then prepare the history again.
Set a screen-lock PIN or password on this phone to approve a private history transfer.
The camera could not scan this code. Close other camera apps and try again.
This sign-in can no longer continue the transfer. Sign in again, then show a new code.
The transfer request is no longer available. Show a new code on the new phone and scan it again.
The history or request changed. Prepare the history again, then show a new code on the new phone.
Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then continue the transfer.
The server could not be reached. Keep both phones connected and try again. The confirmed backup is kept.
Account on this phone: @%1$s
Server: %1$s
Old phone · Send
New phone · Receive
The NEW phone shows the QR. The OLD phone with your history scans it.
This one-time QR connects the two phones. It is not your saved recovery key. Show this screen to the OLD phone.
Before preparing history, the OLD phone needs a screen-lock PIN, password or pattern. You will use it to approve the transfer. UNYRI never receives it. Set it in system settings, then return here.
Set up phone screen lock
Keep the entire white square in view. Scan the NEW phone’s screen from about 20–30 cm away and hold both phones steady.
Creating a one-time request for this new phone…
Verifying your prepared encrypted copy and allowing this phone to receive it…
The QR could not be shown. Close this screen and create a new request. Your saved history is unchanged.
The server is temporarily unable to continue. Keep both phones connected and retry in a moment. Your confirmed copy is safe.
This transfer request could not be accepted. Show a new QR on the new phone and scan it again with the old phone.
This step could not be completed. Try it again. Your history stays on the old phone. If it happens again, send a problem report with the reference below.
Show problem details
Problem reference: %1$s
Use Settings → Help → Report a problem. Include this reference. Do not attach your QR or recovery key.
